title: K80 iOS26 native SMMU context-bank allocator source candidate

basis.previous_snapshot_limit: v60 observed all 22 context banks with CBAR/CBA2R zero and SCTLR.M clear, and all 24 SMR valid bits clear; this was a live snapshot, not a retained software or hardware lease.
basis.controller_claim: The existing native PM owner retains the actual IOService open and active power reference for the exact controller; nativeHeldFor revalidates controller, provider claim, startup gate, active reference, and state. The source restricts this to exact IOService/IOPlatformDevice metaclasses whose default IOService open contract is single-owner.
basis.claim_limit: The controller claim grants no stream-master quiescence, DMA/security/IRQ/global-fault authority, or GPU permission.

implementation.scope: Only the native reserveActual path; accepts only the three exact endpoint objects and packed IDs populated by reserveNativeEndpoints. The external acquireActualBank callback path remains unchanged.
checks: Require retained native controller claim, startup gate, active power reference, ordinary SMMUv2 stream matching, exact 22-bank/24-group K80 geometry, and a read-only MMIO interface.
Read and check CR0 CLIENTPD/EXIDS, GFSR, and global TLBI-active state.
Read all 24 SMR/S2CR groups; reject an active SMR matching the requested ID and avoid any candidate bank targeted by a translation S2CR.
For each bounded candidate bank, read CBAR, CBA2R, and context SCTLR; accept only CBAR=0, CBA2R=0, SCTLR.M=0, and no translation route.
Recheck the retained controller claim around every read and before returning. Store only an in-memory reserved[] bit and retained consumer/source references.

compile.warning_origin: Existing HoujiFullHostNativeMemory.h size_t-to-uint32_t diagnostics; matches v60 compile warning count.

qualification_limits: No runtime bank reservation was attempted or observed.
No fresh package or device scope was created for this candidate.
Independent stream-master quiescence/ownership and SMMU mapping authority remain absent.
No SMMU mapping/translation, GMU firmware, GPU execution, Metal, or touch result is claimed.
next_step: Implement and review a distinct native stream-master quiescence lease while preserving the external grant requirement, then establish mapping/page-table ownership; only after those independent owners exist can a fresh exact-scope hardware trial exercise the allocator.
